dct_description_sm:
Le programme COURDO du RSMA (Réseau de suivi du milieu aquatique) vise documenter la qualité de l’eau des cours d’eau ceinturant l’agglomération montréalaise selon des mesures bactériologiques et physicochimiques. 
-
The COURDO program of the RSMA (Réseau de suivi du milieu aquatique) aims to document the water quality of the waterways surrounding the Montreal agglomeration according to bacteriological and physicochemical measurements.

The COURDO program of the RSMA (Network for Monitoring the Aquatic Environment) aims to document the water quality of the rivers surrounding the Montreal agglomeration according to bacteriological and physicochemical measurements. 
-
The COURDO program of the RSMA (Aquatic Environment Monitoring Network) aims to document the water quality of the waterways surrounding the Montreal agglomeration according to bacteriological and physicochemical measurements.
